SELECT octet_length(id),
    subject_id,
    octet_length(parser_version),
    octet_length(provider),
    sealed,
    octet_length(seal_proof_owner),
    octet_length(seal_proof_incarnation),
    seal_proof_sequence,
    octet_length(seal_proof_kind)
    FROM metadata_evidence WHERE id=?

SELECT octet_length(publication_id),
    entity_id,
    octet_length(provider),
    member_count,
    sealed,
    octet_length(seal_proof_owner),
    octet_length(seal_proof_incarnation),
    seal_proof_sequence,
    octet_length(seal_proof_kind)
    FROM credit_source_publications WHERE publication_id=?

SELECT octet_length(provider_operation_id),
    octet_length(command_incarnation),
    command_sequence,
    octet_length(operation_id),
    octet_length(request_digest),
    octet_length(command_kind),
    accepted_revision,
    applied_ms,
    entity_id,
    octet_length(after_item),
    after_ordinal,
    octet_length(publication_id),
    effective_image_id,
    effective_image_revision,
    result_count,
    octet_length(result_digest),
    seal_version,
    octet_length(seal_evidence_id),
    seal_subject_id,
    octet_length(seal_parser_version),
    octet_length(seal_provider),
    octet_length(seal_subject_kind),
    octet_length(seal_provider_id),
    octet_length(seal_language),
    octet_length(seal_region),
    octet_length(seal_request_shape),
    octet_length(seal_observation_digest),
    seal_owner_generation,
    octet_length(seal_build_id),
    seal_build_generation,
    seal_content_revision,
    octet_length(seal_algorithm),
    octet_length(seal_commitment),
    seal_verified_rows,
    seal_canonical_bytes,
    seal_retained_bytes,
    octet_length(upstream_evidence_owner),
    octet_length(upstream_evidence_incarnation),
    upstream_evidence_sequence,
    octet_length(source_dependency_owner),
    octet_length(source_dependency_incarnation),
    source_dependency_sequence,
    octet_length(source_dependency_publication_id),
    octet_length(source_dependency_provider),
    proof_revision,
    proof_pin_count,
    proof_reclaim_due_ms,
    proof_cleanup_after_sequence
    FROM enrichment_command_receipts WHERE provider_operation_id=? AND command_incarnation=? AND command_sequence=?
